L1_recorder.text_zh: 守则 031：空载工位不计入本批次产能统计。员工离席前须完成当前词条签出手续。
L1_recorder.text_en: Rule 031: Idle workstations are excluded from batch output tallies. Employees must complete sign-out for the current entry before leaving the station.

L2_proofreader.text_zh: 守则 031 注：本条经编校组复核，无修订意见。参见附录 B 工位签出流程。附录 B 暂未随册发放。
L2_proofreader.text_en: Rule 031 note: Reviewed by Editorial Section, no amendments recorded. See Appendix B for workstation sign-out procedure. Appendix B not included in current distribution.

L3_reviser.text_zh: 守则 031 备忘：部分工位签出记录显示词条仍处于经手状态，员工已不在工位。行为档案处已收件，处置结果未抄送本室。
L3_reviser.text_en: Rule 031 memo: Several sign-out logs show entries still flagged as in-process with no employee present. Behavioural Records has acknowledged receipt; disposition not copied to this office.

L4_author.text_zh: 守则 031 原注（档案室留存本）：词条签出后仍检出击键记录，时间戳落在受理窗口内。来源工位当时无人值守。建议补入第七打字室基础守则，待复审委员会签发。
L4_author.text_en: Rule 031 original annotation (archive copy): Keystroke records detected after sign-out, timestamps falling within the acceptance interval. The originating workstation was unattended at the time. Recommended for inclusion in Room Seven base rules; pending Review Committee issuance.
